summary: Frontend-only tablet responsiveness verification. Tested /login, /operator-login at 768x1024 and 820x1180, /register and /list-your-fleet at 820x1180, /portal (driver dashboard) at 820x1180 and 1440x900 desktop regression, plus /driver-guide text-shadow legibility and /admin login. All bug fixes verified working correctly.

tests_executed.login_tablet_820: PASS - headline centered above form, testimonial card centered (mx-auto), form card horizontally centered (form center=410, viewport center=410, offset=0). No overflow.
tests_executed.operator_login_tablet_820_768: PASS - same centering pattern, oplogin-* testids present and centered.
tests_executed.register_tablet_820: PASS - driver-take-home widget centered (x=186 w=448, center=410=viewport center). Interactive driver-car-Electric click updated driver-takehome-value. No overflow.
tests_executed.list_your_fleet_tablet_820: PASS - earnings-estimator widget centered (x=186 w=448 center=410). estimator-slider centered. No overflow.
tests_executed.portal_tablet_820: PASS - portal-hero, portal-documents, portal-compliance, portal-saved-card all at x=24 w=772 (full-width stacked, symmetric margins). No overlap, no overflow. Confirmed grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 change works.
tests_executed.portal_desktop_1440: PASS - two-column bento restored: portal-hero+portal-documents on left (x=168 w=728), sidebar (portal-compliance, portal-saved-card) on right (x=920 w=352). Layout correct.

tests_executed.register_desktop_1440_and_list_your_flee: PASS - widgets on left (x=120), form on right; two-column layout preserved.
tests_executed.driver_guide_tablet: PASS - hero text visible with text-shadow over background image.
tests_executed.admin_login_1440: PASS - admin@caro.co.uk / CaroAdmin2026! logs in successfully and Traction Dashboard renders with metrics (171 leads, 66 drivers, 33 operators).

critical_code_review_comments: All tablet responsiveness changes (text-center lg:text-left, mx-auto lg:mx-0, grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12, [text-shadow:...]) are correctly applied and verified visually + programmatically.
No horizontal overflow on any tested viewport.
